project_type: React SPA with Convex backend, currently Next.js Pages Router, migrating to Vite + TanStack Router
test_command: npm run build (no test suite, build is the verification)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to confirm Vite builds successfully. 2. Check that all route files are created and import correctly. 3. Verify no Next.js imports remain in the src/ directory.
environment_constraints: Full internet access available for npm installs. No Docker needed - static SPA deployment to Netlify.
contribution_requirements: No formal CONTRIBUTING.md. Keep existing code patterns (shadcn/ui, Tailwind, TanStack Query hooks).
key_patterns: - Uses @/ path alias for imports. - TanStack Query hooks in hooks/ directory fetch from Convex backend via ConvexHttpClient. - UI built with shadcn/ui (Radix + Tailwind). - Dark mode via next-themes (will need replacement). - Layout component wraps all pages with header, bottom nav, and FilterProvider. - API routes (/api/proxy-image/[id] and /api/stations/[stationId]) exist for image proxying and station data. The proxy-image route fetches from external JPS server. - PWA config uses next-pwa with manifest.json and sw.js in public/. - Environment variable: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL used by ConvexHttpClient (will become VITE_CONVEX_URL).
directory_structure: Root: pages/ (Next.js pages + API routes), components/ (UI components + icons/ + ui/), hooks/ (TanStack Query + gesture hooks), lib/ (convex client, query client, filter context, utils), styles/ (globals.css), public/ (PWA assets, icons, offline.html), utils/ (haptics, location, time), convex/ (backend functions), netlify/ (Netlify functions), scripts/ (scraping scripts), types/ (type defs)
